requirement_text: 0 serious/critical violations; WCAG 2.1 AA; keyboard-only operation of all actions
record_type: automated axe scans and a keyboard-only browser journey

keyboard_journey.name: a core alias journey is operable by keyboard alone
keyboard_journey.method: Tab from document start to the Label input, type the label, Tab to Create alias, press Enter, assert the alias row appears. No pointer input is used.

runs.harness: web/scripts/run-e2e.mjs (disposable PostgreSQL 17 + API + Vite + Chromium stack)

verdict: PASS - zero axe violations across public, signed-in user and signed-in admin pages at WCAG 2.1/2.2 A/AA, and the keyboard-only core alias journey passed in five fresh-stack runs.
caveats: The automated keyboard check covers the core alias-creation journey, not literally every action in the product; the 'all actions' clause still relies on the per-release manual keyboard checklist.
axe findings are a point-in-time scan of the listed routes and themes; the brand guide's dark-mode scan uses emulated media rather than a persisted preference in a separate browser context.
